title: T23 desktop: Lantern light lamp 200 120 0
head: t23-lantern-lamp
body:
## What

- Owner decision: Lantern's light `lamp` is now `200 120 0` (was `240 181 69`) — ~3.14:1 against `light.bg` (`#f7f5f0`), clears decision #167's 3:1 `lamp`/`bg` rule (was ~1.69:1). The dark lamp stays `255 201 92`, unchanged.
- `src/design/tokens.ts`: `tokens.light['--oasis-lamp']` and `LANTERN.tokens.light.lamp` (the theme-pack mirror of the same value, contract §5) both updated to `'200 120 0'`. Matches the format already used everywhere else in this file (an `R G B` triplet string, not hex, since `--oasis-lamp` feeds `rgb(var(--oasis-lamp) / a)`).
- `tests/tokens.test.ts`: the pinned "bundled Lantern pack is exactly today's values" snapshot for `light` now asserts `'--oasis-lamp': '200 120 0'`.
- No contrast test in this repo carried a known-exception for the light lamp (the desktop `check-contrast.ts`/`contrast.test.ts` suite never checks `lamp` against `bg` directly — only through the lit-wash mix over `surface-raised`, which already passes at both old and new values); nothing to remove there. The direct `lamp`/`bg` 3:1 rule and its now-closed exception live in `playbooks` (`themes/lantern/theme.yaml`, `tests/test_themes_validate.py`), covered in that repo's own PR.
- Version 0.1.0 → 0.1.1: `package.json`, `package-lock.json` (root `oasis-rig` entries only), `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`, `src-tauri/Cargo.toml`, `src-tauri/Cargo.lock` (the `oasis-rig` package entry only — unrelated crates already pinned at `0.1.0`, e.g. `vswhom`, `windows-threading`, left alone). `CHANGELOG.md` entry added under `## Unreleased`.

## Checks

<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check

No stash/scratch-copy run (not allowed here) — named by reasoning over the diff instead:

1. Mutant: revert `tokens.ts`'s `tokens.light['--oasis-lamp']` back to `'240 181 69'` (leave `LANTERN.tokens.light.lamp` at the new value). Killed by `tests/tokens.test.ts`'s `it.each(['light','dark'])("the bundled Lantern pack is exactly today's %s values")`, light case: the `toMatchObject({ ..., '--oasis-lamp': '200 120 0', ... })` assertion fails immediately against the reverted `'240 181 69'`.
2. Mutant: revert only `LANTERN.tokens.light.lamp` back to `'240 181 69'` (leave `tokens.light['--oasis-lamp']` at the new value) — the two would then disagree. Killed by the same test's per-field equality loop, `for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(values)) expect([name, value]).toEqual([name, tokens[theme][name as keyof ...]])`: `LANTERN`'s `lamp` (`'240 181 69'`) no longer equals `tokens.light['--oasis-lamp']` (`'200 120 0'`), so the loop's assertion for `'--oasis-lamp'` fails.
